calibration.DGP: bounded sign common latent AR plus per-arm sign noise; same market block shared by assets and arms
calibration.acceptance: tool integrity and DGP-conditional diagnostics only; no winner or empirical requiredN from synthetic success

costs.limits: scenarios are not actual fills/fee tiers/executable profitability

protocol.historical_exclusion: 2025-01 through2025-06 and all010-015 DEV/OOS/quote samples are already viewed; archive replay is engineering only

partition.DEV: future eligible receipts after freeze; first separate time block
partition.OOS: strictly later unviewed future data, no refit; purge>=4h and one7day embargo
partition.cross_asset: BTC/ETH pooled in SAME calendar-week block; no asset-week pseudo replication
partition.qualification: between-week independence must be externally justified or inference HOLD; no estimated event-N treated as certified effectiveN

prediction.candidate: fixed unit-domain R transform; explicit feature group formulas in code, no fitted weights
prediction.exploratory: DEV-only empirical CDF Q; not a primary comparison or OOS refit
prediction.loss: squared prediction loss on bounded target; paired baseline_loss-candidate_loss in[-1,1]

primary_family.method: Bonferroni simultaneous Hoeffding for bounded INDEPENDENT block means; independence not inferred from event count

sample_size.N_required: null until independent-data calibration/power justified; analytic independent planning numbers never qualifiedN

protocol.source: Binance Spot public BTCUSDT ETHUSDT, closed5m plus closed30m/4h and completed daily/ISO-week contexts
protocol.stopping: no optional peeking/retuning thresholds; amend version and freeze before any changed experiment; no actual collector activation under016
